asm_ida_com:
push    rbp
mov     rbp, rsp
movsd   [rbp+C1], xmm0
movsd   [rbp+S1], xmm1
movsd   [rbp+C2], xmm2
movsd   [rbp+S2], xmm3
mov     [rbp+C], rdi
mov     [rbp+S], rsi
movsd   xmm0, [rbp+C1]
movsd   xmm2, [rbp+C2]
movsd   xmm1, [rbp+S1]
mulsd   xmm1, [rbp+S2]
movq    rax, xmm1
mov     rcx, 8000000000000000h
xor     rax, rcx
movq    xmm1, rax
mulsd   xmm0, xmm2
addsd   xmm0, xmm1
mov     rax, [rbp+C]
movsd   qword ptr [rax], xmm0
movsd   xmm0, [rbp+S1]
movsd   xmm2, [rbp+C2]
movsd   xmm1, [rbp+C1]
mulsd   xmm1, [rbp+S2]
mulsd   xmm0, xmm2
addsd   xmm0, xmm1
mov     rax, [rbp+S]
movsd   qword ptr [rax], xmm0
pop     rbp
retn
